name: ScenarioSession
description:
CFG9 selectors: Gen2 sessions S0-S3 and ZK firmware inventory modes.

Use with InventoryConfig.session or QueryParameters.session for Scenario.
Extended values do not identify an on-air Gen2 session. Firmware support
and scheduling vary; S_CST uses the three profile slots in CFG31.

name: TagTarget
description: Exactly one full EPC or nonempty mask. None in an API means unfiltered.

name: InventoryConfig
description:
Inventory options; applicable fields depend on InventoryMode.

Scenario takes Q, session selector, phase, TID and mask from this object,
temporarily overriding CFG9/10/11. It uses the reader's existing CFG31.
Use ScenarioSession names or integers for its session selector. Target is
0 (A) or 1 (B); scan_time_100ms controls Answer rounds, not Scenario duration.

name: Region
description:
Native ZK band ID and inclusive, zero-based channel limits.

For a linear band, frequency_khz = base_khz + channel * spacing_khz.
Equal limits select one channel. This does not configure a custom region.

name: CustomRegion
description: Custom channel centers in kHz; radio and regulatory limits remain device-specific.

name: QueryParameters
description:
Scenario CFG9: Q (0-15), session/mode selector, and phase reporting.

session accepts ScenarioSession or its integer value. start_inventory()
temporarily replaces these settings with its InventoryConfig values.

name: rssi_to_dbm
description:
Project-defined RSSI estimate: raw 60 -> -75 dBm, 110 -> -25 dBm.

This is a reference-point estimate, not a vendor-calibrated reading.
All uint8 values use raw - 135; outside 60..110 this extrapolates without
clamping. Decoded reports retain raw, source and an in-range flag.

name: phase_to_degrees
description:
Convert one uint16 phase word using Form1.cs's 0.087 deg/tick.

By default fold into [0, 180), matching the vendor's normal inventory
display. wrap=False returns the scaled word without folding. This is
a vendor display convention, not evidence of calibrated absolute phase.

name: phase_to_radians
description: Radians of phase_to_degrees; folded values are in [0, pi).

name: TraceEvent
description: Host monotonic timestamp; raw bytes are wire bytes, never inferred RF timing.

name: TraceEmitter
description: A synchronous observer must return promptly; observer errors never affect RF I/O.

name: RFProfile
description:
Known RF parameters for a native profile ID; availability is firmware-specific.

modulation, pie and tari_us describe the reader-to-tag link; blf_khz and
encoding describe the tag reply. Metadata alone does not establish RF
performance or support on the attached reader.

name: Dispatcher
description:
Timeout/cancellation after TX poisons this connection until explicit recovery.

open(recover=True) is an assertion by the caller that the old device operation
has ended and stale bytes cannot arrive (e.g. physical reset/reconnection).
Closing a port alone does not stop reader RF.

signature: Dispatcher.exchange(self, command: int, data: bytes=b'', *, timeout=3.0, deadline: float | None=None, terminal=None, on_frame=None) -> tuple[ResponseFrame, ...]

name: Dispatcher.interrupt_answer
description: Send 0x93 only while 0x01 is pending; it has no independent ACK.

name: collect_answer
signature: collect_answer(reader, config, *, timeout, request=None, managed=False, on_report=None)

name: InventorySession
description:
Async iterator of TagReport or Heartbeat with explicit stop and final outcome.

Scenario applies volatile CFG9/10/11 and an antenna mask, verifies them,
and restores snapshots after a confirmed stop. CFG31 is not managed or restored.
Real-time uses the saved 0x75 configuration; start/stop changes only the
current working mode. Call drain() after stop() to collect queued events.
Stream outcome stores counters; the consumer owns delivered report storage.

name: InventorySession.stop
description:
Stop, settle trailing frames, and restore managed settings.

Cancellation waits for cleanup before propagating. Drain queued events
separately; inspect complete/diagnostics before treating the run as successful.

name: InventorySession.drain
description:
Take queued events after stop(), even when its outcome is incomplete.

Use one consumer. This does not read the port or clear Stop diagnostics.
Quarantined post-ACK frames are retained in outcome, never in this queue.

name: ZKReader.close

name: ZKReader.get_serial_number

name: ZKReader.get_power

name: ZKReader.set_write_power

name: ZKReader.set_write_retries

description: Get the native antenna mask; the 16-port getter remains unverified.

name: ZKReader.set_antenna_check
description: Enable or disable the reader's antenna connection check (0x66).

name: ZKReader.get_antenna_check
description: Read the antenna-check flag from reader information (0x21).

name: ZKReader.set_address
description: Change reader address after receiving the ACK at the original address (0x24).

name: ZKReader.set_baudrate
description: Receive ACK at the old baud, then switch the transport baud (0x28).

name: ZKReader.set_inventory_time
description: Set native scan time in 100 ms units: 0 or 3..255 (0x25).

name: ZKReader.set_interface
description: Select usb or uart (0x6A); effective after a module power cycle.

name: ZKReader.get_region
description: Read the active native region or CustomRegion (0x9E).

name: ZKReader.set_region
signature: ZKReader.set_region(self, region: Region, *, persist: bool=False, legacy: bool=False) -> CommandResult[None]
description:
Set a native band and inclusive channel limits (0x22).

Equal limits select one channel. Use set_custom_region() for start/count/spacing.
persist=False uses the volatile extended format;
legacy=True requires persist=True and a band ID at most 15.

name: ZKReader.get_custom_region
description: Read active custom channels, or None when a native region is active (0x9E).

name: ZKReader.set_custom_region
signature: ZKReader.set_custom_region(self, start_frequency_khz: int, channel_count: int, spacing_khz: int, *, persist: bool=False) -> CommandResult[None]
description:
Set custom channel centers (0x22, band 0xFF); volatile by default.

Count is 1..61; spacing_khz is in kHz, in multiples of 125, up to 31875
(zero only for one channel). Demo Space=4 means spacing_khz=500.
Frequencies must fit 24-bit kHz. These are encoding
limits, not supported RF bands or operating permissions. Read back to verify.

name: ZKReader.get_profile
description: Read native RF profile ID, including the 16-bit Ex10 format (0x7F).

name: ZKReader.set_profile
signature: ZKReader.set_profile(self, profile_id: int, *, persist: bool=False, extended_format: bool=True) -> CommandResult[int]
description:
Select one native RF profile (0x7F); this does not configure S-CST slots.

Use PROFILES for known parameters, not firmware support detection.
Extended format accepts 16-bit IDs; legacy format accepts IDs 0-63.

name: ZKReader.set_drm

name: ZKReader.set_range_control
signature: ZKReader.set_range_control(self, value: int, *, persist: bool=False) -> CommandResult[None]

Set native Range Control to 0..100 (CFG16); volatile unless persist=True.

No conversion to distance, dB or percentage is established.

name: ZKReader.set_query_parameters
signature: ZKReader.set_query_parameters(self, parameters: QueryParameters, *, persist: bool=False) -> CommandResult[None]
description:
Set Scenario Q, session/mode selector, and phase reporting (CFG9).

start_inventory() overrides CFG9 with its InventoryConfig for the duration

description: Set Scenario TID selection; word_count=0 selects EPC instead (CFG10).

description: Read CFG11 as TagMask, or None when disabled; raw_data retains the wire payload.

name: ZKReader.set_inventory_mask
signature: ZKReader.set_inventory_mask(self, mask: TagMask | None, *, persist: bool=False) -> CommandResult[None]
description: Set the inventory selection mask, or pass None to clear it (CFG11).

name: ZKReader.get_custom_profiles
description: Read the three ordered S-CST RF profile slots (CFG31).

name: ZKReader.set_custom_profiles
signature: ZKReader.set_custom_profiles(self, profile_ids: tuple[int, int, int], *, persist: bool=False) -> CommandResult[None]
description:
Set three ordered S-CST profile IDs (CFG31); repeated IDs are allowed.

This does not activate S-CST. Start Scenario with config.session set to
ScenarioSession.S_CST. InventorySession does not snapshot or restore CFG31;
persist=False avoids saving to nonvolatile storage, not session cleanup.
Firmware controls profile switching; its timing is not specified here.

name: ZKReader.set_real_time_config
description: Persist the dedicated 0x75 real-time settings; separate from Scenario CFG.

name: ZKReader.get_working_mode
description: Read the current mode and real-time configuration (0x77), not the boot mode.

name: ZKReader.set_working_mode
signature: ZKReader.set_working_mode(self, mode: WorkingMode, *, persist: bool=False) -> CommandResult[None]
description:
Set the current mode; persist=True also changes the mode used at boot.

For managed 0xEE delivery use start_inventory(). Closing a direct mode
connection does not stop autonomous inventory. Switching to Answer settles
old reports and verifies the mode before allowing another inventory.

name: ZKReader.set_heartbeat_interval

name: ZKReader.set_buffer_length

name: ZKReader.get_buffer_count

name: ZKReader.clear_buffer

signature: ZKReader.inventory_to_buffer(self, config: InventoryConfig=InventoryConfig(), *, timeout: float | None=None) -> CommandResult[BufferCounts]
description: Run buffered inventory and return counts; this changes reader buffer contents (0x18).

name: ZKReader.read_buffer
signature: ZKReader.read_buffer(self, *, data_kind: InventoryData=InventoryData.EPC, timeout: float | None=None) -> InventoryOutcome
description: Collect all 0x72 frames; preserve partial reports and enforce one overall deadline.

name: ZKReader.inventory_once
signature: ZKReader.inventory_once(self, config: InventoryConfig=InventoryConfig(), *, timeout: float | None=None) -> InventoryOutcome
description: Run one Answer/Mix round, preserving reports on partial completion or timeout.

name: ZKReader.inventory_single
description: Run native single-tag inventory (0x0F).

name: ZKReader.inventory_matching_epc
signature: ZKReader.inventory_matching_epc(self, data: bytes, bit_length: int, *, bit_offset: int=0, exclude: bool=False, timeout: float | None=None) -> InventoryOutcome
description: Run native EPC-bit-match inventory with explicit bit offset and length (0x1A).

name: ZKReader.start_inventory
signature: ZKReader.start_inventory(self, mode: InventoryMode=InventoryMode.SCENARIO, *, config: InventoryConfig=InventoryConfig(), queue_size: int=1024, trigger: bool=False, antenna_mask: int | None=None, antenna_sequence: tuple[int, ...] | None=None) -> InventorySession
description:
Start a managed report stream; stop explicitly or use its context manager.

Scenario applies config to CFG9/10/11 and antenna selection, then restores
changed settings after a confirmed stop. CFG31 remains caller-managed.
scan_time_100ms does not limit Scenario duration; the application stops it.
Scenario antenna_mask selects one or more ports (bit0=ANT1), overriding
config.antenna. If omitted, config.antenna selects one port as before.
The reader controls antenna cycling; no host Start/Stop loop is added.
Answer antenna_sequence repeats one bounded round per listed port in order;
it overrides config.antenna and does not modify the saved antenna mask.

name: ZKReader.stop_inventory
description:
Stop by mode-specific semantics; 0x93 has no ACK of its own.

An unknown reader without an owned session returns an incomplete outcome;
no stop opcode can safely be inferred from the absence of a session.
Stop waits for pending Start preparation and completes cleanup even if cancelled.
